newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel to eye 130.46, then pull back.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel to eye 130.46, then pull back.

text.p: September notionnel futures traded on MATIF may edge slightly higher on Thursday but the downside bias will prevail, technical analysts said.
"For today I'm looking for a small rise to 130.44/46 before notionnel slips to 130.10 again," said Christian Bado, senior technical analyst at Ferrier Lullin in Geneva.
He said on Tuesday the contract had broken out of its upward channel which suggested further losses. In the medium term he said notionnel would head down towards 129.40.
At 0843 GMT, September notionnel futures were at 130.40, up 26 basis points on the day.
Elli Gifford, an independent technical analyst near Cambridge, said for now notionnel was likely to consolidate.
"I don't anticipate any major movement at the moment," she said. "But there is some potential for notionnel to weaken. It has 130.00 as obvious support which I suspect will hold."
"It will deteriorate quite quickly if it gets through there," she said.
On the upside, she said initial resistance was at 130.38. That level is the high so far this session.
Above there, further resistance would step in around 130.70 and then the 130.88 contract high.
At the short end, September Pibor futures were at 96.50, up one basis point on the day.
